pains.label: Blew up my account or lost a big chunk of my savings on options: how do I make it back?
pains.definition: The writer (or the thread) reports losing a large sum, the whole account or their savings trading options (0DTE, Bank Nifty option buying, selling premium) and often asks how to recover it.

pains.label: I keep losing money on options and don't know what I'm doing wrong
pains.definition: Ongoing losses rather than one blow-up: the writer asks why they (or most traders, or option buyers) always lose, what mistakes they make and how to stop losing.

pains.label: Devastated and full of regret after a trading loss: how do you cope?
pains.definition: The emotional aftermath of trading losses: regret, feeling sad or stupid, can't enjoy life, asking how others stay calm or cope.

pains.label: Can't control my emotions: revenge trading, overtrading, trading like gambling
pains.definition: Discipline and compulsion problems: revenge trades after a loss, overtrading, greed and fear, options trading that feels like a gambling addiction.

pains.label: Is this course, Discord or mentor worth the money, or a scam? I paid for one that didn't help
pains.definition: Doubts about, or bad experiences with, paid options education, mentorship, Discord communities and alert services: is it worth it, which one to pick, fake gurus, scams, wasted money.

pains.label: Lost money to Telegram tips channels, fake advisers and copy-trading scams
pains.definition: Tips or signal channels on Telegram or WhatsApp, unregistered advisers, impersonators and copy-trading schemes that take traders' money; how to tell which channel is genuine.

pains.label: Assignment, margin calls or my broker's actions cost me money by surprise
pains.definition: Surprises from options mechanics and broker actions: early assignment or exercise, physical settlement, margin shortfall penalties, margin calls, forced liquidation and broker errors that leave the trader owing money or losing positions.

pains.label: Taxes on active options trading are a mess: wash sales, 1099-B, trader tax status (US)
pains.definition: US tax pain from many trades: wash sales that disallow losses, confusing 1099-B forms, trader tax status and the section 475 election deadline, needing special software or a CPA.

pains.label: How do I show my F&O loss in the ITR, and do I need a tax audit? (India)
pains.definition: Indian F&O traders unsure how to file: which ITR form, how turnover is counted, when a tax audit is compulsory, carrying losses forward, penalties for not reporting.

pains.label: SEBI's new F&O rules (bigger lots, fewer weekly expiries, more margin) hit small traders (India)
pains.definition: Rule changes by SEBI and the exchanges that raise capital needs, add margin, cut weekly expiries, collect option premium upfront or regulate retail algos; traders ask how they are affected.

pains.label: Small account: the $25,000 pattern day trader rule and too little capital hold me back
pains.definition: Traders with small accounts blocked by the pattern day trader rule's day-trade limit or by too little capital, and looking for a way around it (US regulators scrapped the $25,000 minimum in 2026).

pains.label: Can options trading replace my job? Quitting to trade full time backfired
pains.definition: Whether trading can realistically become the main income, whether to keep the job and trade alongside it, when to quit, and regret after quitting to trade full time.

pains.label: Paying for data, charting, analytics, journals and backtesting adds up: which are worth it?
pains.definition: The cost of real-time options data, charting and analytics subscriptions, trade journals and historical data for backtesting; hidden fees; whether a paid tool is worth it or a free way exists.

pains.label: Paid prop-firm evaluation fees, then failed or got the payout denied
pains.definition: Funded-trader programs: repeated evaluation fees, rule traps, denied payouts and prop-firm scams.

pains.label: Brokerage, commissions, STT and hidden charges eat my profits: why are my trading costs so high?
pains.definition: The per-trade costs of active options trading: broker commissions and brokerage, India's STT (securities transaction tax, charged on each trade), including the 'STT trap' on in-the-money options held to expiry, exchange transaction charges, stamp duty and other fees. Traders ask why their charges are so high, how to calculate them, how to cut them or which broker is cheapest. Data, charting and tool subscriptions belong to tool-data-costs-add-up. Filing income tax belongs to the tax pains.

pains.label: Should I take a personal loan to trade? I borrowed to trade and now I'm in debt
pains.definition: Trading with borrowed money: personal loans, credit cards or loans against property taken to fund options or F&O trading or to win back losses; asking whether borrowing to trade is a good idea; debt left after trading losses. Losing one's own savings with no debt belongs to blew-up-account. A small account with no borrowing belongs to small-account-pdt.
